letter.title: A steadier week
paragraphs: You made 90 calls and were close to calibrated at 70 to 80%.
Your 90% calls hit 78% of the time: that is the one to watch.

drills.title: Wheel check at 90%
drills.text: Before each 90% call, ask whether you would bet on a wheel that wins nine times in ten.

items.text: By 30 November 2026, the first snowfall of the season will be recorded at Seattle-Tacoma airport.
By Friday, I will finish the draft of the report.
By tomorrow evening, I will walk 8,000 steps.

abc-123.ref: first snowfall in November, Seattle, since 1990

abc-123.text: The outside view said 35% and you said 60%; the chain leaned on one signal.
